title: Chocolate Brown Christmas Decor
headline: Chocolate Brown Christmas Decor: 8 Amazon Finds for a Warm, Moody Holiday Tree
seo_title: Chocolate Brown Christmas Decor: 8 Amazon Finds | Looks Like Luxe
description: Chocolate brown Christmas decor from Amazon: velvet bows, brown ornaments, a faux fur tree skirt, velvet ribbon and more. Eight best-reviewed picks for a rich holiday look.
intro: Forget red and green for a minute. A chocolate brown Christmas looks warm, grown-up and a little bit rich-girl.
I built a chocolate brown Christmas decor list with velvet bows, ribbon, ornaments and a faux fur tree skirt. Every pick is rated 4.4 stars or higher, and each has a brown or chocolate color option.
On every product page, choose the Chocolate Brown (or listed brown) color option before you buy, since many of these come in several colors.
I haven't tested them. Think of this as a head start on tree styling. Let's go.
disclosure: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases, which means if you tap a link and buy, I may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you. Prices, colors and availability live on Amazon and change often.

interludes.3: A chocolate Christmas works because it's one color in many textures.
interludes.6: Keep one metallic accent, like gold, to make the brown glow.

If you take one thing from this guide, let it be this. Bows plus a faux fur skirt is the fastest way to a designer-looking tree.
